patch_description: To maximize `tm_sizes_average` and `applied_lambdas_proportions`, I am implementing the "Ultra-High Initial Fuel" (500) and "95/5 Asymmetric Splitting" strategy. Additionally, I'm introducing "Beta-Redex Injection" which manually constructs a `LamTm` on the function side of an `AppTm` with 30% probability when the budget is high. This forces applied lambdas into the spine even when the target type doesn't naturally require one. I've also increased the context-driven argument selection to 95% to ensure the small argument branch is almost always satisfied by a `VarTm`, boosting variable reuse.
